test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Arvind works 4 times as fast as Suresh. If Suresh can complete a work in 20 days independently, then find the number of days in which Arvind and Suresh can together finish the work.
solution:
**Given:**

Arvind works 4 times as fast as Suresh.

Suresh can complete a work in 20 days independently.

**Formula Used:**

Work Rate = Work / Time

Combined Work Rate = Sum of Individual Work Rates

Time to Complete Work = Total Work / Combined Work Rate

**Calculation:**

Let the total work be W.

Suresh's work rate = W / 20

Arvind's work rate = 4 × (W / 20) = W / 5

Combined work rate = (W / 20) + (W / 5)

Combined work rate = (W / 20) + (4W / 20)

Combined work rate = 5W / 20

Combined work rate = W / 4

Time to complete work together = Total Work / Combined Work Rate

Time to complete work together = W / (W / 4)

Time to complete work together = 4 days

**The number of days in which Arvind and Suresh can together finish the work is 4 days.**
